clue.text: Unwell no end, having caught a sunburn — diabolical

indicators.note: the trimmed word catches the next pieces and holds them inside it
with no end, the final letter of the synonym is cut off

parts.note: unwell means sick
a sunburn is a tan

explanation.surface: Someone sick and sunburnt on holiday feels absolutely devilish.
explanation.definitionFit: Satanic means devilish, like the Devil himself, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Reliable social worker missing in Santa Fe

indicators.note: a worker who is missing from the place name has had its letters taken out

parts.note: the ant is the classic social insect, a worker in its colony

explanation.surface: A dependable social worker has gone absent somewhere in New Mexico.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Social worker' suggests a welfare officer; here it is an ANT, removed from SANTAFE to leave the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Something safe is dependable, without risk, so the words are synonyms.

clue.text: Pitcher in jail after brawl initially stops play

indicators.note: the jail word comes after the rest in the answer
the letter plugs or stops up the middle of the word for play

parts.note: to toy is to play

indicators.note: initially points to the first letter of brawl

parts.note: jug is slang for jail

explanation.surface: A pub brawl lands someone in jail and halts the game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pitcher' suggests baseball, but it is a jug for pouring.
explanation.definitionFit: A Toby jug is a type of pitcher shaped like a seated man in a tricorn hat.

clue.text: Info's turned up about one horse nicker

indicators.note: the reversed word goes around the next piece
in a down clue, turned up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: gen is slang for information; the possessive adds no letter
one is the Roman numeral I
H is slang for heroin, which is called horse

explanation.surface: Information about a whinnying horse surfaces.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned up' reverses GEN to NEG; 'about' puts I inside, giving NEIG, then H.
explanation.definitionFit: To nicker is to whinny softly, the same horse sound as a whinny, so the verbs match.

clue.text: Stand up for hospital concealing bloomer? Quite the opposite

indicators.note: concealing signals one piece hidden inside another
this reverses the stated roles, so the flower conceals the hospital letter

parts.note: a campion is a flowering plant, a thing that blooms

explanation.surface: Defending a hospital that hides its blunders, or the reverse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bloomer' reads as a mistake but is a flower; 'Quite the opposite' reverses 'concealing', so CAMPION hides H.
explanation.definitionFit: To champion a cause is to support or defend it, an exact synonym.

clue.text: Song about knave in Greek district

indicators.note: about means the song goes around the next word

parts.note: an aria is an operatic song
a cad is a dishonourable man, a knave

explanation.surface: A ballad about a rogue set in a region of Greece.
explanation.definitionFit: Arcadia is a region of the Peloponnese in Greece.

clue.text: Approach a meeting place

parts.note: a venue is where people meet

explanation.surface: Approaching a spot where people gather.
explanation.definitionFit: An avenue is a way of approach, often a tree-lined drive to a house.

clue.text: Punch shared in overpriced nightclub

parts.note: to clip is to hit or punch
joint means shared, as in a joint account

explanation.surface: A punch-up breaks out in a pricey club.
explanation.definitionFit: Clip joint is slang for a club or bar that overcharges its customers.

clue.text: Systematic search to find colourful fish — nothing escapes

indicators.note: something that escapes gets out, so this letter leaves the word

parts.note: a dragonet is a brightly coloured small fish
nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: A thorough trawl for a bright fish catches everything.
explanation.definitionFit: A dragnet is a wide-ranging, systematic search, especially by police.

clue.text: Layers of cloud excited artist a lot

indicators.note: excited suggests the letters are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: Banks of cloud stirred up a painter greatly.
explanation.definitionFit: Altostratus is a mid-level sheet cloud; the plural form names layers of it.

clue.text: Frenchman stopping at forge

indicators.note: the Frenchman is stopped up with the next word inside him

parts.note: Fabrice is a French man's name

explanation.surface: A Frenchman pauses at a blacksmith's forge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Forge' looks like a blacksmith's workshop in the surface; it is the verb, the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To forge something can mean to make it up or invent it falsely, a synonym.

clue.text: At home a gym is unsuitable

parts.note: at home means in
PT, physical training, is gym class

explanation.surface: A home gym is not fit for purpose.
explanation.definitionFit: Inapt means not suitable or appropriate, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Recent pope's introduced judge to US navy commander

indicators.note: the judge letter is introduced into the pope's name

parts.note: John Paul I, pope in 1978, gives the name with ONE'S, the possessive read as the plain plural

explanation.surface: A modern pontiff presents a judge to an American naval officer.
explanation.walkthrough: The recent pope is John Paul I, with his numeral written out as a word; the possessive supplies its final letter.
explanation.definitionFit: John Paul Jones was the Scottish-born commander regarded as father of the US Navy.

clue.text: Tossed salad lover in the country

indicators.note: tossed, as a salad is, means the letters are thrown about

explanation.surface: A salad enthusiast in a foreign land.
explanation.definitionFit: El Salvador is a Central American country.

clue.text: Large military force surrounded at mission

indicators.note: the force surrounds the next word, holding it inside

parts.note: a legion is a large body of soldiers

explanation.surface: A big army surrounded at an embassy.
explanation.definitionFit: A legation is a diplomatic mission headed by a minister, ranking below an embassy.

clue.text: Plenty of these in Boot Hill, here

definitions.text: Plenty of these in Boot Hill, here

parts.words: Plenty of these in Boot Hill, here
parts.note: Boot Hill is the famous cemetery of an Arizona town, so the grave markers are plentiful there and the town itself is also the place meant by here

explanation.surface: A Wild West graveyard is full of grave markers in its own town.
explanation.walkthrough: Boot Hill is the Old West cemetery in the Arizona town of the same name as the grave markers.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the grave markers in the cemetery and the town that holds it.

clue.text: Nurse demanding cut is bandaged

indicators.note: the next word is bandaged, wrapped inside the trimmed word
cut means the end letter is cut off the synonym

parts.note: stern means demanding or strict

explanation.surface: A strict nurse dresses a wound.
explanation.walkthrough: A sister is the British title for a senior ward nurse.
explanation.definitionFit: A sister is a senior nurse in charge of a hospital ward in Britain.

clue.text: Argued against article written by editor

parts.note: an article is an object, a thing

explanation.surface: An editor protested about an article.
explanation.definitionFit: To have objected is to have raised an argument against something.

clue.text: Familiar with a husband shown in book

indicators.note: the husband letter is shown inside the book word

parts.note: a tome is a big book

explanation.surface: Comfortable with a husband pictured in a book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Familiar with' reads as one phrase; 'with' is the link, as in being familiar with something.
explanation.definitionFit: Being at home with something means feeling familiar and comfortable with it.

clue.text: Half of solution is covered by forceful political publication

indicators.note: the shortened word is covered over by the outer one, held inside it

parts.note: hard means forceful, as in a hard push

indicators.note: half of means the second half of the synonym is dropped

parts.note: an answer is a solution

explanation.surface: A forceful official journal has half the answers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Half of' cuts ANSWER to ANS, which 'is covered by' HARD. Hansard is the official record of the UK Parliament's debates.
explanation.definitionFit: Hansard is the published verbatim report of British parliamentary debates.

clue.text: A bishop's treatise, hard to understand

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop, and the 's adds an S
a tract is a short treatise

explanation.surface: A churchman's essay is heavy going.
explanation.definitionFit: Abstract thinking is theoretical and so difficult to grasp.

clue.text: Musical instruction unfortunately at an end

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests the words have been broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A sad musical direction at the close of a piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Andante is a tempo marking telling players to go at a moderate walking pace.

clue.text: An old calculator can make a graduate swear endlessly

parts.note: a BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a graduate

indicators.note: endlessly means the last letter of the swear word is dropped

parts.note: to cuss is to swear

explanation.surface: A dated machine makes a graduate curse without end.
explanation.walkthrough: The opening 'An' doubles as part of the definition; the wordplay's A comes from 'a' before 'graduate'.
explanation.definitionFit: The abacus is an ancient counting frame with beads, an early calculator.

clue.text: Goddess seen in play

parts.note: Venus is the Roman goddess of love
observed means seen

explanation.surface: A goddess is spotted in a drama.
explanation.definitionFit: Venus Observed is a 1950 verse play by Christopher Fry.

clue.text: Essential to establish temperature in medicine bottle

indicators.note: in places the temperature letter inside the bottle word

parts.note: a vial is a small bottle for medicine

explanation.surface: Checking temperature in a medicine phial is crucial.
explanation.definitionFit: Vital means absolutely necessary, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Typical of beech trees

indicators.note: of signals the letters are taken from within the following words

explanation.surface: Characteristic of beech trees.
explanation.definitionFit: Echt, borrowed from German, means genuine or typical of its kind.

clue.text: Old eccentric type, revolutionary archon

indicators.note: a revolution turns something round, so the word is reversed

parts.note: a card is an eccentric or amusing person

explanation.surface: An old oddball revolutionary served as an Athenian magistrate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' reverses CARD to DRAC, then O. An archon was a chief magistrate of ancient Athens.
explanation.definitionFit: Draco was the Athenian archon famous for his harsh law code.

clue.text: In a stupefied state, Tom will need a pick-me-up later

parts.note: a tom is a male cat
a tonic is a pick-me-up

explanation.surface: A dazed man called Tom will want a reviving drink later on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tom' looks like a man's name; it is a tomcat.
explanation.definitionFit: A catatonic person is in a stupor, motionless and unresponsive.

clue.text: Put right about costume

parts.note: re means about or concerning
a dress is a costume or outfit

explanation.surface: Fixing a problem with an outfit.
explanation.definitionFit: To redress a wrong is to put it right or remedy it.

clue.text: Most insensitive Secretary of State, close to Taft

parts.note: John Foster Dulles was US Secretary of State under Eisenhower

indicators.note: close here means end, so the last letter of Taft is taken

explanation.surface: The least sensitive US official, standing near a president.
explanation.definitionFit: Dull can mean insensitive or obtuse, and this is its superlative form.
